unitEvidence: The frozen Oxford preprocessing copies raw ang_vel XYZ and acc XYZ directly into sensor_msgs/Imu angular_velocity and linear_acceleration SI fields.

decimation.method: union of six-axis min/max sample rows per replay-time bin plus every video-frame anchor

timeMapping: Piecewise linear sourceTime-to-time map between video keyframe anchors; repeated camera timestamps hold the nearest recorded IMU measurement; final video frame is held to clip end.
clockEvidence: The frozen Oxford preprocessing uses camera filename seconds and IMU secs/nsecs as the same recording clock, with no fixed preprocessing time shift. Demo anchors retain the camera timestamp. No online VIO-estimated temporal offset is applied to this recording visualization.
